items.title: For Automakers, RISC-V Isn’t Just About Ownership: It’s About Freedom of Choice
items.summary: MIPS’ Sameer Wasson explains why an automotive OEM’s choice of instruction set architecture (ISA) should prioritize supplier choice, software reuse and long-term economic control. The post For Automakers, RISC-V Isn’t Just About Ownership: It’s About Freedom of Choice appeared first on RISC-V International .
items.title_zh: MIPS高管：车企选择RISC-V不仅是自主可控，更是供应商选择自由
items.summary_zh: MIPS公司Sameer Wasson撰文指出，汽车厂商在选择指令集架构(ISA)时，应优先考虑供应商可选性、软件复用以及长期经济控制能力，而RISC-V正是契合这一需求的关键。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 车企ISA选型关乎供应链韧性与生态话语权，RISC-V的多供应商模式有助于打破单一架构锁定。

items.title: CVITEK CV1842H-P-based edge AI camera module offers night vision and AI-ISP support (Crowdfunding)
items.summary: The AIMORELOGY Ovis is an open-source AI vision camera module built around the CVITEK CV1842H-P SoC, with full-color 1080p night vision and 1.5 TOPS edge AI inference in a compact modular design. It is designed for drones, robotics, security systems, smart cameras, and custom embedded vision products. The camera features a compact stacked design, with a 20 × 20 mm Core board that includes the CVITEK CV1842H-P SoC, 2 Gbit NAND flash, USB, and UART debug pads. A Sensor board with the SC235HAI image sensor connects on top and also adds Ethernet and UART interfaces. An optional CVBS board goes between the Sensor board and the Ovis Core board. items.title: Morse Micro Wi-Fi HaLow USB adapters add 802.11ah connectivity to PCs and routers
items.summary: Last year, we saw Morse Micro introduce the MM8108 Wi-Fi HaLow (802.11ah) SoC with up to 43.33 Mbps throughput, along with an MM8108-RD09 USB dongle reference design, for which we had virtually no details at the time. Morse Micro has now released USB-A and USB-C Wi-Fi HaLow adapters based on that reference design. The adapters let PCs and routers connect to 802.11ah networks through USB without a dedicated expansion card and feature an external SMA antenna delivering up to 26 dBm transmit power. Wi-Fi HaLow USB network adapter specifications: SoC – Morse Micro MM8108 32-bit RISC-V Host Applications Processor (HAP) Standard – IEEE802.11ah Wi-Fi HaLow Frequency band – 850-950 MHz (Worldwide sub-1 GHz license-exempt range) Operating Modes – Access Point (AP) and Station (STA). Channel Width – 1/2/4/8 MHz Modulation – BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM, 256QAM. Data rate – Up to 43.3 Mbps using 256-QAM modulation at an 8 MHz bandwidth [...] The post Morse Micro Wi-Fi HaLow USB adapters add 802.11ah connectivity to PCs and routers appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: Morse Micro推出Wi-Fi HaLow USB适配器，基于RISC-V MM8108芯片
items.summary_zh: Morse Micro发布USB-A和USB-C接口的Wi-Fi HaLow适配器，基于32位RISC-V内核的MM8108 SoC，支持802.11ah标准，工作在850-950 MHz免许可频段，最高43.3 Mbps速率，外置SMA天线提供26 dBm发射功率，可让PC和路由器直接通过USB接入HaLow网络。
items.why_it_matters_zh: RISC-V芯片首次以USB适配器形态进入Wi-Fi HaLow市场，降低了物联网设备接入门槛。

items.title: JetKVM Mini – A low-cost, ESP32-P4X-based KVM with Ethernet or WiFi connectivity
items.summary: JetKVM Mini is a smaller, lower-cost version of the popular JetKVM KVM over IP solution. The new model features a small information display, offers Ethernet or WiFi connectivity, and supports 1080p video capture. The main under-the-hood change is that they ditched Linux on a Rockchip RV1106G3 SoC and now rely on an ESP32-P4X (ESP32-P4 version 3.x and greater) to handle video capture, H.264 encoding, USB, and other features. The largest cost saving is removing the RAM and eMMC flash required by Linux. JetKVM Mini specifications: SoC – Espressif Systems ESP32-P4X CPU Dual-core 32-bit RISC-V HP (High-performance) CPU @ up to 400 MHz with AI instruction extension and single-precision FPU Single-RISC-V LP (Low-power) MCU core @ up to 40 MHz Memory 768 KB HP L2MEM (for dual-core CPU), 32 KB LP SRAM, 8 KB TCM (for LP MCU core) 32 MB PSRAM Storage – 128 KB HP ROM, 16 KB LP ROM [...] The post JetKVM Mini – A low-cost, ESP32-P4X-based KVM with Ethernet or WiFi connectivity appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: JetKVM Mini发布：基于ESP32-P4X的双核RISC-V低成本KVM方案
items.summary_zh: JetKVM Mini是JetKVM的低成本版本，搭载乐鑫ESP32-P4X芯片，集成双核32位RISC-V HP CPU（400 MHz）和单核LP MCU（40 MHz），无需Linux系统即可处理1080p视频采集、H.264编码和USB功能，支持以太网或Wi-Fi连接，配备小尺寸信息显示屏。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 采用RISC-V MCU取代Linux SoC方案，大幅降低KVM成本与功耗。

items.title: ESP32-C5 Pico board follows Raspberry Pi Pico form factor, ships with on-board or external antenna
items.summary: Waveshare ESP32-C5 Pico board brings the ESP32-C5 dual-band WiFi 6, Bluetooth LE, and 802.15.4 (Zigbee/Thread) SoC to the Raspberry Pi Pico form factor. The board features an ESP32-C5-MINI-1 Series module with PCB or external antenna, two 20-pin GPIO headers, a USB-C port for power and programming, Reset and Boot buttons, and a few LEDs. It also supports Li-Ion battery charging and discharging. Waveshare ESP32-C5 Pico specifications: Wireless module – ESP32-C5-MINI-1 or ESP32-C5-MINI-1U Wireless MCU – Espressif Systems ESP32-C5HF4 CPU Single-core 32-bit RISC-V processor @ up to 240 MHz Low-power RISC-V core @ 48 MHz acting as the main processor for power-sensitive applications Memory – 384 KB SRAM on-chip Storage – 320 KB ROM, 4MB SPI flash Wireless Dual-band (2.4/5 GHz) 802.11ax WiFi 6, 802.11b/g/n WiFi 4 backward compatibility WiFi modes: Station mode, SoftAP mode, SoftAP + Station mode, and promiscuous mode Bluetooth 5.0 Low Energy (LE) with Mesh support, up [...] The post ESP32-C5 Pico board follows Raspberry Pi Pico form factor, ships with on-board or external antenna appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: Waveshare推出ESP32-C5 Pico开发板，兼容树莓派Pico外形规格
items.summary_zh: Waveshare推出ESP32-C5 Pico开发板，采用ESP32-C5-MINI-1模块，支持双频WiFi 6、低功耗蓝牙和802.15.4（Zigbee/Thread）。板载单核32位RISC-V处理器，主核频率240MHz，低功耗核48MHz，配备384KB SRAM和4MB SPI闪存。提供PCB板载天线或外置天线两种版本，配有双20针GPIO排针、USB-C接口、Reset和Boot按键，并支持锂电池充放电。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 首款集成双频WiFi 6与RISC-V内核的Pico尺寸开发板，为物联网和多协议无线应用提供了低成本、易原型设计的硬件平台。

items.title: YuzukiNeko – A Linux-capable Allwinner F101 RISC-V SBC with Raspberry Pi Pico form factor
items.summary: YuzukiHD has made another open-source hardware Linux SBC. YuzukiNeko is a Raspberry Pi Pico-sized single board computer powered by a new Allwinner F101 RISC-V SoC. The Allwinner F101 processor features a single 1.008 GHz C907 RISC-V core, 8MB or 16 MB PSRAM, and support for various display interfaces such as MIPI DSI, 24-bit RGB, and LVDS. The YuzukiNeko board itself features the F101 SoC, an SPI NOR flash, a microSD card for storage, a USB-C port, and two 20-pin GPIO headers. YuzukiNeko specifications: SoC – Allwinner F101 CPU – T-head C907 RISC-V core up to 1.008 GHz Memory – 8MB or 16MB PSRAM @ 252 MHz Package – QFN-68 Storage 128 Mbit NOR flash (PY25Q128HA-SUH-IT) MicroSD card slot USB – USB Type-C port for data, power, and programming Expansion 2x 20-pin expansion headers with GPIOs, ADC, 5V, 3.3V, and GND 5x pads with HP out (analog speaker output) and four [...] The post YuzukiNeko – A Linux-capable Allwinner F101 RISC-V SBC with Raspberry Pi Pico form factor appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: YuzukiNeko：搭载全志F101的RISC-V Linux单板机
items.summary_zh: YuzukiHD开源设计YuzukiNeko单板机，采用Raspberry Pi Pico外形规格，搭载全志F101 SoC，内置单核T-head C907 RISC-V核心，主频达1.008GHz，配备8MB或16MB PSRAM。板载128Mbit SPI NOR闪存、MicroSD卡槽、USB-C接口及双20针GPIO排针，支持MIPI DSI、24位RGB和LVDS显示接口，可运行Linux系统。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在树莓派Pico的紧凑尺寸内实现可运行Linux的RISC-V计算平台，兼顾显示输出与开源扩展，降低RISC-V入门门槛。

items.title: Linux 7.4 Slated To Land The AVX-512 Optimized xor_gen For A Big Performance Win
items.summary: Over the past few months there have been patches floating around for an AVX-512 optimized xor_gen() for the Linux kernel for that functuon used by the Linux software RAID code. It's been shhowing very nice performance gains with this function being used for generating and validating parity blocks such as for RAID5 and RAID6. The upcoming Linux 7.4 cycle is slated to merge this nice enhancement for benefiting AMD Zen 4 and newer or current Intel server CPUs with AVX-512...

items.title: Removing Drivers For Outdated ARM Platforms Will Lighten The Kernel By ~247k Lines
items.summary: The Linux kernel is going to see the removal of a number of recently deprecated ARM 32-bit platforms. Following the deprecation in Linux 7.3, removing the old ARM platforms will lighten the kernel by around 55k lines of code. But removing now unused drivers only relevant to those platforms will mean roughly a quarter million lines of code can be removed from the kernel source tree...

A second revision of those patches hit the mailing list this morning and there is hope they could be upstreamed for Linux 7.4...

items.title: GPIBee (UsbGpib V3) USB-to-GPIB adapter gains Ethernet (PoE), but launches as closed-source hardware
items.summary: Last December, we wrote about XyphroLabs’s UsbGpib open-source hardware, affordable, and portable USB-to-GPIB adapter designed for legacy GPIB/IEEE-488 instruments and offering modern hardware and software. At the time, the UsbGpib V3 was also in the works with Ethernet (PoE) support, and the good news is that it’s now available, but named GPIBee. The less good news is that while V1 and V2 were both open-source hardware products (and still are), the GPIBee has been released as closed-source hardware for reasons we’ll explain below. GPIBee specifications: Microcontroller – Not disclosed. But not the Microchip ATMega32U4 8-bit AVR MCU found in V2 since its USB interface is limited to 12 Mbps Host interfaces USB 2.0 (480 Mbps) Type-C port with support for four modes Full USBTMC (USB Test and Measurement Class) VXI-11 over USB-Ethernet (CDC NCM) linux-gpib native interface Prologix-compatible (++ commands) via CDC UART (virtual COM port) 10/100Mbps Ethernet RJ45 port [...] The post GPIBee (UsbGpib V3) USB-to-GPIB adapter gains Ethernet (PoE), but launches as closed-source hardware appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: GPIBee (UsbGpib V3) USB转GPIB适配器新增以太网(PoE)支持，但转为闭源硬件
items.summary_zh: XyphroLabs推出GPIBee，基于UsbGpib V3设计，新增以太网和PoE供电支持。但与此前开源的V1和V2不同，GPIBee转为闭源硬件。其MCU未公开（非V2所用的Microchip ATMega32U4），配备USB 2.0 Type-C接口，支持USBTMC、VXI-11 over USB-Ethernet (CDC NCM)、linux-gpib原生接口及Prologix兼容模式。
items.why_it_matters_zh: GPIBee提升了USB转GPIB适配器的连接能力，但闭源策略与前代开源路线相反，可能影响用户社区参与和硬件可定制性。
